monsters.name: Necromancer

spells.Cantrips: Chill Touch, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion

spells.1st level: Mage Armor, Ray of Sickness, Magic Missile

traits: The necromancer can animate one corpse per day as a skeleton or zombie.
when the necromancer kills a creature with a spell of 1st level or higher
they regain hit points equal to twice the spell’s level.
actions: target must make a Constitution saving throw.
reactions: the necromancer can cast Shield to gain +5 AC until the start of their next turn.

traits.name: Ferocious Charge
traits.desc: If the knight moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and hits with a melee weapon attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) slashing damage and must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Duelist Instinct
traits.desc: When the knight has no other creature within 5 feet of them except their target, their weapon attacks deal an extra 3 (1d6) damage.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6+5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Throwing Axe (2/Day)
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8+4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Reckless Cleave (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The knight swings wildly in a horizontal arc. Each creature within 5 feet of the knight must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 11 (2d6+4) slashing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: When a creature the knight can see hits them with a melee attack, the knight can use their reaction to add +2 to their AC against that attack.

monsters.name: Cultist Warlock
spells: Spellcasting (Charisma). The cultist warlock is a 5th-level spellcaster. Spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks. It has the following spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): eldritch blast, mage hand, minor illusion
1st level (4 slots): armor of Agathys, hex

traits.name: Dark Devotion
traits.desc: The cultist warlock has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

traits.name: Pact Boon
traits.desc: Choose one pact boon when you use this creature—Pact of the Chain (an imp familiar), Pact of the Blade (summons a wicked ritual dagger), or Pact of the Tome (a blasphemous grimoire). The pact boon doesn’t change the cultist warlock’s statistics.

traits.name: Weakened Fireball
traits.desc: The cultist warlock’s fireball is an unstable rite. When it casts fireball, it deals 5d6 fire damage (instead of 8d6) in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point the warlock can see within 150 feet. Each creature in the area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking full damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Flammable objects in the area that aren’t being worn or carried ignite.

actions.name: Ritual Dagger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Eldritch Blast
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10+5) force damage.

actions.name: Weakened Fireball (2/Day)
actions.desc: The cultist warlock casts weakened fireball (see Weakened Fireball trait).

reactions.name: Malevolent Rebuke
reactions.desc: When the cultist warlock takes damage from a creature it can see within 60 feet, it can use its reaction to deal 5 (1d10) psychic damage to that creature.

monsters.name: Intellect Devourer
monsters.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 12
monsters.languages: understands Deep Speech but can't speak, telepathy 60 ft.

traits.name: Detect Sentience
traits.desc: The intellect devourer can sense the presence and location of any creature within 300 feet of it that has an Intelligence of 3 or higher, regardless of interposing barriers. It knows the creature's Intelligence score but not its identity.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4+2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Devour Intellect
actions.desc: The intellect devourer targets one creature it can see within 10 feet of it that has a brain. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Intelligence saving throw against this magic or take 11 (2d10) psychic damage. Also on a failure, roll 3d6: If the total equals or exceeds the target’s Intelligence score, that score is reduced to 0. The target is stunned until it regains at least 1 point of Intelligence.

actions.name: Body Thief
actions.desc: The intellect devourer initiates an Intelligence contest with an incapacitated humanoid within 5 feet of it that has a brain (it rolls 3d6 and adds its Intelligence modifier; the humanoid adds its Intelligence modifier). If it wins the contest, the intellect devourer magically consumes the target’s brain and teleports into the target’s skull. The intellect devourer then takes control of the target’s body, replacing the target’s brain. The intellect devourer retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as its understanding of Deep Speech, its telepathy, and its traits. It otherwise adopts the target’s statistics, except it retains this action. The possessed body’s AC is 12 unless its armor gives a higher AC. The intellect devourer can end this possession at any time (no action required). The body drops prone if the intellect devourer ends the possession. A protection from evil and good spell cast on the body drives the intellect devourer out. The intellect devourer is also forced out if the target regains its devoured brain, which can happen only by wish.

monsters.name: Wispbound Bride
monsters.languages: understands Common and one other language but can't speak clearly (see False Soul), telepathy 30 ft.

traits.name: False Soul
traits.desc: The bride can speak only in short phrases and remembered fragments. Creatures that knew the warlock (or observe for 1 minute) can tell something is wrong with a DC 12 Insight check.

traits.name: Unstable Binding
traits.desc: If the bride starts its turn in bright light, it has disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Anchor Rune
traits.desc: A creature within 5 feet of the bride can use an action to make a DC 12 Arcana or Religion check to disrupt the binding rune on the corpse. On a success, the bride takes 5 (1d10) psychic damage and can't use Flicker Step until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Luminous Touch
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8+2) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Grief Flash (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The bride emits a burst of soul-light. Each creature of its choice within 10 feet must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails the save also can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Flicker Step (1/Turn)
bonus_actions.desc: The bride teleports up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. It can do so only if it starts its turn in dim light or darkness.
